===Some more thank yous===
'''''Posted by Harriet on October 11th, 2006 in the Robert Jordan's Blog category'''''


Dear all: Most sincere thanks from Robert Jordan (via Harriet) go out to

Michael J. Fredericks, Jean Verney-Carron, Evan Harmon, Lisa Kirwood,Ryan Salsamendi, Emma de Laat (hello, Emma!),David Freeman, Helena Taylor and Janet Taylor

for gifts to the Mao Hematologic Malignancies Program — amyloidosis research. Thank you one and all.

Jim is taking it easy today, since we go up to the Mayo tomorrow for a routine workup — but as a consolation prize, here is a poem of mine:


Bard: n., a full set of equine armor.



Your head seethes with essential magic,<br />its glittering chanfron deep and wise,<br />high-buffed, strong in dream and reason.<br />and your escutcheon shining pure.<br />The crinet of your glistening neck,<br />articulated, burnished,<br />glides swiftly to the brazen peytral<br />of your great roomy chest.<br />On it emblazoned script in gothic flame:<br />Live in today, live for tomorrow.<br />Your flanchards bearing you in strength,<br />shine bright below your gleaming crupper.<br />And for your groin: festooned galloons,<br />fine textiles in a nest, and heavy gold.<br />All worlds flare in your burning eyes,<br />as soul and words bring fat new flames<br />to the pale page, and to my greedy heart.


Hope you enjoy it . You have all been a wonderful support for both of us…. I guess this is a little thank-you token. Best, Harriet
